# owner: platform
"""Weekly timesheet rows, one line of text per worker."""

from typing import List

from hourglass.schedule import worker_minutes
from hourglass.models import Shift
from collections import Counter


def _check(shifts: List[Shift]) -> None:
    if not shifts:
        raise ValueError("no shifts to report")
    if any(not s.worker.strip() for s in shifts):
        raise ValueError("shift has a blank worker name")


def _row(name: str, count: int, minutes: int) -> str:
    return f"{name}: {count} shifts, {minutes / 60:.1f} h"


# ---
def timesheet_lines(shifts: List[Shift]) -> List[str]:
    """One line per worker, most scheduled time first."""
    _check(shifts)
    minutes = worker_minutes(shifts)
    counts = Counter(s.worker for s in shifts)
    names = sorted(minutes, key=lambda n: (-minutes[n], n))
    return [_row(n, counts[n], minutes[n]) for n in names]
